admin.webhooks.title.description: Heading of the webhooks screen, and its link in the administration menu.

admin.webhooks.updated_at.description: Term in a webhook's details: when its URL, description or events last changed.

admin.webhooks.url.description: Label of the URL that a webhook posts its messages to.

admin.webhooks.url.description.description: Help of the URL of a webhook.

api.error.network.defaultMessage: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
api.error.network.description: Error message when a request to the server got no answer (offline, or the server is down).

api.error.offline.defaultMessage: You are offline, so the server cannot be reached. Connect to the internet and try again.

bookmarks.title.description: Heading and document title of the page that lists the posts the user bookmarked. Bookmarks are private.

compose.close.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes the new-post sheet. The draft is kept.

compose.failed.description: Error after publishing a post failed. The draft is kept. {reason} is the error message.

compose.language.label.description: Label of the choice of the language a post is written in.

compose.language.und.description: Choice of post language when the user does not say which language the post is in.

compose.media.add.description: Button that opens the file picker to attach images, a video, or an audio file to a post.

compose.media.count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# file attached} other {# files attached}}
compose.media.count.description: Description of the button that attaches media, while the post has some. {count} is how many files.

compose.media.description.hint.defaultMessage: Describe it for people who cannot see or hear it.
compose.media.description.hint.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attached image, video, or audio file.

compose.media.description.label.description: Label of the alternative text field of an attached image, video, or audio file. {position} is its number in the post, from 1.

compose.media.description.required.defaultMessage: Describe it for people who cannot see or hear it. Your settings ask for a description of every attachment.
compose.media.description.required.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attachment when the user's settings ask for a description of every attachment.

compose.media.description.server_require.defaultMessage: Describe it for people who cannot see or hear it. This server requires a description of every attachment.
compose.media.description.server_require.description: Help text under the alternative text field of an attached image, video, or audio file when the server requires a description of every image (the instance setting require_media_description).

compose.media.description.missing.defaultMessage: Add a description of this attachment. This server requires one for every attachment.
compose.media.description.missing.description: Error of the alternative text field of an attached image, video, or audio file that has no description while the server requires one for every image.

compose.media.failed.description: State of an attached file whose upload failed. {reason} is the error message.

compose.media.failed_processing.defaultMessage: The server could not process this file.
compose.media.failed_processing.description: Why an attached file failed: the server could not process it.

compose.media.hint.defaultMessage: Up to {max, plural, other {# files}}: JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP images, MP4 or WebM video, or MP3, Ogg, or M4A audio. Location and other metadata are removed.
compose.media.hint.description: Help text next to the button that attaches media. {max} is the most files a post can have. JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP, MP4, WebM, MP3, Ogg, M4A are format names (not translated).

compose.media.list.description: Accessible name of the list of images, videos, and audio files attached to the post being written.

compose.media.processing.description: State of an attached file while the server prepares it.

compose.media.remove.description: Button that removes an attached file from the post. {position} is its number in the post, from 1.

compose.media.too_many.defaultMessage: A post can have at most {max, plural, other {# files}}. The rest were not added.
compose.media.too_many.description: Notice when the user picked more files than a post can have. {max} is the most files a post can have.

compose.media.unsupported.defaultMessage: {name} is not a JPEG, PNG, GIF, or WebP image, an MP4 or WebM video, or an MP3, Ogg, or M4A audio file.
compose.media.unsupported.description: Notice when a picked file is not a type the server accepts. {name} is the file name. The format names are not translated.

compose.media.uploading.description: State of an attached file while it is being sent to the server.

compose.mention.unreached.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {{accounts} is on another server and does not follow you, so they will not receive this post. compose.mention.unreached.description: Warning under a post with the visibility 'This server' that mentions accounts of other servers that do not follow the author (ADR-0017, ADR-0035): those accounts do not receive the post, and the author's followers on other servers see the mention as a plain link, not as a mention. {accounts} is the list of their handles, for example '@carol@remote.example and @dave@other.example'; {count} is how many there are.

compose.missing_description.add.description: Button of the confirmation that goes back to the form to describe the images.

compose.missing_description.body.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# image has no description.} other {# images have no description.}} People who cannot see the images will not know what they show.
compose.missing_description.body.description: Text of the confirmation about images without a description. {count} is how many images have none.

compose.missing_description.post.description: Button of the confirmation that posts without the descriptions.

compose.missing_description.title.description: Title of the confirmation shown when attached images have no description and the user's settings ask for one.

compose.open.description: Floating button on phones and tablets that opens the form for a new post.

compose.outbox.discard.description: Button that throws away a post that could not be sent.

compose.outbox.edit.description: Button that puts a post that could not be sent back into the form.

compose.outbox.failed.description: State of a post that could not be sent. {reason} is the error message.

compose.outbox.label.description: Accessible name of the list of posts that are being sent or could not be sent.

compose.outbox.retry.description: Button that sends a post that could not be sent again.

compose.outbox.sending.description: State of a post that is being sent.

compose.outbox.unsent.description: State of a post whose sending was interrupted (for example by reloading the page).

compose.over.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character too many} other {# characters too many}}
compose.over.description: Counter under a text field when the text is longer than allowed. {count} is how many characters are over.

compose.posted.description: Notice after a post was published.

compose.remaining.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
compose.remaining.description: Counter under a text field: how many more characters fit. {count} is a number.

compose.reply.cancel.description: Button that turns the reply being written into a normal post.

compose.reply.label.description: Above the new-post form: the post being replied to. {name} is the author's display name or handle.

compose.reply.unavailable.defaultMessage: The post you are replying to cannot be shown.
compose.reply.unavailable.description: Shown instead of the post being replied to when it could not be loaded.

compose.sensitive.defaultMessage: Hide the images until readers show them
compose.sensitive.description: Checkbox that marks the attached images as sensitive.

compose.submit.description: Button that publishes the new post.

compose.submit.reply.description: Button that publishes the reply being written.

compose.text.label.description: Label of the text area where the user writes the text of a post.

compose.title.description: Heading of the form that writes a new post (the side panel on wide screens, the sheet on phones).

compose.visibility.button.description: Button that opens the choice of who can see the post. {visibility} is the current choice, for example 'Public'.

compose.visibility.ceiling.defaultMessage: Your account can post at most as “{visibility}” right now. A wider choice is posted as “{visibility}”.
compose.visibility.ceiling.description: Hint in the choice of visibility while a restriction on the account narrows what it can post. {visibility} is the widest visibility it can use, for example 'Followers'.

compose.visibility.direct.description: Visibility of a post: only the mentioned people.

compose.visibility.done.description: Button that closes the list of visibility choices.

compose.visibility.limited.defaultMessage: Posted with the visibility “{visibility}”: your account cannot post more widely right now.
compose.visibility.limited.description: Notice after posting when the server narrowed the chosen visibility because of a restriction on the account. {visibility} is the visibility the post got, for example 'Followers'.

compose.visibility.local.description: Visibility of a post: signed-in people of this server and the author's followers. Not the same as 'local only' in other software: followers on other servers receive it.

compose.visibility.private.description: Visibility of a post: the author's followers and the mentioned people.

compose.visibility.public.description: Visibility of a post: everyone, and listed on the public timelines.

compose.visibility.public.description.defaultMessage: Anyone, here and on other servers. Shown on the public timelines.

compose.visibility.title.description: Label of the list of visibility choices for a post.

compose.visibility.unlisted.description: Visibility of a post: everyone, but kept off the public timelines.

compose.visibility.unlisted.description.defaultMessage: Anyone with the link, but not shown on the public timelines.

compose.warning.description.description: Help text under the content warning field.

compose.warning.label.description: Label of the field with the content warning text of a post.

compose.warning.toggle.description: Toggle button (an icon) that adds a content warning: a short text shown instead of the post until the reader opens it.

documents.label.description: Accessible name of the links to the server's terms of service and privacy policy (in the third column, the menu, the settings, and the sign-in page), and the heading of their section in the settings.

documents.privacy_policy.description: Link to the server's public page of its privacy policy.

documents.terms.description: Link to the server's public page of its terms of service.

home.title.description: Heading and document title of the home timeline page.

landing.registrations.invite.defaultMessage: Only people with an invite can create an account.
landing.registrations.invite.description: Note next to the landing page's registration link, when only people with an invite may sign up.

landing.registrations.closed.defaultMessage: This server is not accepting new accounts.
landing.registrations.closed.description: Text on the landing page, in place of the registration link, when nobody may sign up.

landing.about.title.description: Heading of the landing page's section with the server's description.

landing.rules.title.description: Heading of the landing page's section with the server's rules.

landing.posts.title.description: Heading of the landing page's section with a few recent public posts of this server's accounts.

landing.posts.more.description: Link under the recent posts of the landing page to the local timeline.

landing.posts.failed.description: Heading shown in place of the recent posts of the landing page when they could not be loaded.

local.title.description: Heading and document title of the page with the public posts of this server's accounts.

login.title.description: Heading and document title of the page that starts signing in.

notifications.appeal.overturned.defaultMessage: Your appeal was granted, and the action was lifted.

notifications.appeal.upheld.defaultMessage: Your appeal was not granted, and the action stays.
notifications.appeal.upheld.description: In an appeal_decided notification: the moderators kept the action that the user appealed.

notifications.empty.all.description: Heading shown on the notifications page when the user has no notifications.

notifications.filter.all.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows notifications of every type.

notifications.filter.favourites.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only favourites of the user's posts.

notifications.filter.follows.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only new followers, follow requests and accepted follow requests.

notifications.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the tab list that filters the notifications by type.

notifications.filter.mentions.description: Tab on the notifications page that shows only posts that mention the user.

notifications.group.boost.defaultMessage: {name} and {count, plural, one {# other} other {# others}} boosted your post

notifications.group.favourite.defaultMessage: {name} and {count, plural, one {# other} other {# others}} favourited your post
notifications.group.favourite.description: Notification sentence for several favourites of one of the user's posts, grouped in one row. {name} is the display name of the newest account that favourited it; {count} is the number of the other accounts that did (1 or more).

notifications.link.account_status.description: Link in a moderation notice notification to the page with the moderation actions on the user's account.

notifications.link.appeal.description: Link in a moderator's notification of a new appeal to the appeal's admin page.

notifications.link.followers.description: Link in a notification of follows ended by a suspension to the user's list of followers.

notifications.link.following.description: Link in a notification of follows ended by a suspension to the list of accounts the user follows.

notifications.link.registrations.description: Link in a moderator's notification of a new sign-up to the registration review screen.

notifications.link.report.description: Link in a moderator's notification of a new report to the report's admin page.

notifications.link.webhooks.description: Link in an administrator's notification of a disabled webhook to the webhooks screen.

notifications.load_more.description: Button at the end of the notifications that loads older ones.

notifications.loading.description: Visually hidden text that names the busy list of notifications while its first page loads.

notifications.moderation.action.description: In a moderation notice notification: what the action on the user's account does ({kind}, e.g. 'Suspension') and the reason category ({category}, e.g. 'Spam'), both already translated by the server.

notifications.moderation.until.description: In a moderation notice notification: when the action on the user's account ends by itself; {date} is a formatted date and time.

notifications.post.content_warning.description: A notification's link to the post it is about, when the post is behind its author's content warning: the warning only. {summary} is the warning's text.

notifications.post.open.description: A notification's link to the post it is about, when the post has no text to quote (pictures only).

notifications.report_resolved.account.defaultMessage: Your report on {name} has been resolved
notifications.report_resolved.account.description: Notification sentence: the moderators resolved the user's report; {name} is the reported account's name, a link to its profile.

notifications.retry.description: Button that loads the notifications again after they failed to load.

notifications.severed.account.defaultMessage: The moderators suspended {name}. You lost {followers, plural, one {# follower} other {# followers}} and {following, plural, one {# account you followed} other {# accounts you followed}}.
notifications.severed.account.description: Notification sentence: the moderators of this server suspended a remote account, which ended the follows between it and the user in both directions; they are not restored when the suspension ends. {name} is the display name of the suspended account. {followers} is the number of the suspended accounts that followed the user, {following} the number of those that the user followed (either may be 0).

notifications.severed.domain.defaultMessage: The moderators suspended {domain}. You lost {followers, plural, one {# follower} other {# followers}} and {following, plural, one {# account you followed} other {# accounts you followed}} there.
notifications.severed.domain.description: Notification sentence: the moderators of this server suspended another server, which ended the follows between its accounts and the user in both directions; they are not restored when the suspension ends. {domain} is the server's domain name. {followers} is the number of the suspended accounts that followed the user, {following} the number of those that the user followed (either may be 0).

notifications.sign_in.description: Link on the notifications page, when nobody is signed in, that opens the sign-in page.

notifications.signed_out.defaultMessage: Sign in to see your notifications.
notifications.signed_out.description: Text on the notifications page when nobody is signed in.

notifications.title.description: Heading and document title of the notifications page.

notifications.type.admin_appeal.defaultMessage: A new appeal awaits the moderators
notifications.type.admin_appeal.description: Notification sentence to a moderator: a user appealed a moderation action on their account.

notifications.type.admin_report.defaultMessage: A new report awaits the moderators
notifications.type.admin_report.description: Notification sentence to a moderator: someone reported an account that had no open report.

notifications.type.admin_sign_up.description: Notification sentence to a moderator. {name} is the display name, or the username, of a new user whose registration waits for a moderator's approval.

notifications.type.admin_webhook_disable.defaultMessage: The server disabled a webhook that kept failing
notifications.type.admin_webhook_disable.description: Notification sentence to an administrator: the server disabled a webhook whose endpoint kept failing or answered that it is gone.

notifications.type.appeal_decided.description: Notification sentence: the moderators upheld or overturned the user's appeal of a moderation action on their account.

notifications.type.boost.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that boosted the user's post.

notifications.type.favourite.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that favourited the user's post.

notifications.type.follow.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the new follower.

notifications.type.follow_accepted.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that accepted the user's follow request.

notifications.type.follow_request.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that asked to follow the user.

notifications.type.mention.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the author of a post that mentions the user.

notifications.type.moderation_notice.defaultMessage: The moderators of this server sent you a notice
notifications.type.moderation_notice.description: Notification sentence: a notice to the user from the moderators of the server.

notifications.type.poll_closed.defaultMessage: A poll you took part in has ended
notifications.type.poll_closed.description: Notification sentence: a poll that the user created or voted in has closed.

notifications.type.reaction.description: Notification sentence. {name} is the display name of the account that reacted to the user's post with an emoji; {emoji} is the emoji, or the :shortcode: of a custom emoji.

notifications.type.relationships_severed.defaultMessage: A suspension by the moderators ended some of your follows
notifications.type.relationships_severed.description: Notification sentence when the details of the suspension are no longer available: the moderators of this server suspended a server or an account, which ended follows between it and the user.

notifications.type.report_resolved.defaultMessage: A report you filed has been resolved
notifications.type.report_resolved.description: Notification sentence: the moderators of the server resolved a report that the user filed. It never says how.

notifications.unread.description: Read by screen readers before the sentence of a notification that was new when the page opened.

notifications.unread_count.description: The number of unread notifications on the badge of the navigation item, for example '3 unread'.

page.not_built.defaultMessage: This screen is not ready yet.

shell.nav.menu.description: Button of the bottom tab bar on phones that opens a sheet with the rest of the navigation (profile, settings). Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bar of five items on a 320 px screen.

shell.nav.menu_pending.defaultMessage: Menu, {count, plural, one {# pending in moderation} other {# pending in moderation}}
shell.nav.menu_pending.description: Accessible name of the phone tab bar's Menu button while things await the moderators in the moderation, which the menu leads to; starts with the visible label.

shell.nav.moderation.description: Navigation item to the moderation screens, shown only to users whose roles have a moderation permission.

shell.nav.moderation_pending.defaultMessage: Moderation, {count, plural, one {# pending} other {# pending}}
shell.nav.moderation_pending.description: Accessible name of the navigation item to the moderation screens while open reports, registrations or appeals wait for the moderators; starts with the visible label.

shell.nav.notifications.description: Navigation item that opens the notifications. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.notifications_unread.defaultMessage: Notifications, {count, plural, one {# unread} other {# unread}}
shell.nav.notifications_unread.description: Accessible name of the navigation item that opens the notifications while some are unread. Start it with the text of shell.nav.notifications, which is shown. {count} is the number of unread notifications.

shell.nav.profile.description: Navigation item that opens the user's own profile. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the side rail of tablets and in the menu sheet of phones.

shell.nav.public.description: Navigation item that opens the federated timeline (public posts of this server and of other servers). Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the bottom tab bar of phones and in the side rail of tablets.

shell.nav.search.description: Navigation item that opens the account search. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in a bottom tab bar.

shell.nav.settings.description: Navigation item that opens the settings. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the side rail of tablets and in the menu sheet of phones.

shell.nav.sign_in.description: Navigation item, shown while nobody is signed in, that opens the sign-in page and comes back to the current page. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the bottom tab bar of phones and in the side rail of tablets.

shell.nav.sign_up.description: Navigation item, shown while nobody is signed in and the server takes new accounts, that opens the server's registration page. Keep it short: it is shown under an icon in the side rail of tablets and in the menu sheet of phones.

shell.nav.viewer.defaultMessage: The account you are signed in with
shell.nav.viewer.description: Description read after the name of the link at the bottom of the desktop sidebar that shows the signed-in account (avatar, display name, handle) and opens its profile.

shell.not_found.body.defaultMessage: There is no page at this address.
shell.not_found.body.description: Text on the page shown for an address that the web client has no page for.

shell.not_found.home.description: Link on the not-found page back to the home timeline.

shell.not_found.title.description: Heading of the page shown for an address that the web client has no page for.

shell.offline.defaultMessage: You are offline. Anything that failed to load loads again when you are back online.
shell.offline.description: Text of the bar at the top of the app while the device is offline or the server cannot be reached. Screen readers announce it when it appears.

shell.rate_limited.defaultMessage: Too many requests were sent to the server. What failed to load loads again at {time}.
shell.rate_limited.description: Text of the bar at the top of the app while the server's rate limit refuses requests (HTTP 429). {time} is the time of day the app loads again, with seconds (for example 12:34:56). Screen readers announce it when it appears.

shell.skip_to_main.description: Link at the very start of every page, visible when focused, that moves keyboard focus past the navigation.

shell.startup_error.body.defaultMessage: The server sent settings the app cannot read. Reload the page; if this keeps happening, tell the server's administrator.
shell.startup_error.body.description: Text shown instead of the app when its runtime configuration from the server is missing or invalid.

shell.startup_error.title.description: Heading shown instead of the app when its runtime configuration from the server is missing or invalid.

shell.toast.dismiss.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes a toast message.

shell.toast.region.description: Accessible name of the area where short status messages (toasts) appear, such as 'Post published'.

shell.update.apply.description: Button in the message about a new version of the app; pressing it reloads the page into the new version.

shell.update.available.defaultMessage: A new version of the app is available.
shell.update.available.description: Message shown when a new version of the web app has been downloaded and waits until the user applies it.

status.action.bookmark.description: Toggle button under a post that bookmarks it or removes the bookmark. Bookmarks are private. The same text is used in both states.

status.action.boost.description: Toggle button under a post that shares (boosts) it with the user's followers, or retracts the boost. The same text is used in both states.

status.action.copy_link.description: Menu item that copies the address of a post to the clipboard.

status.action.delete.description: Menu item, on the user's own post, that asks to delete it.

status.action.edit.description: Item of a post's More actions menu, for the user's own posts: opens the dialog that edits the post.

status.action.failed.description: Toast when boosting, favouriting or bookmarking a post failed; the button is set back. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.action.favourite.description: Toggle button under a post that adds it to or removes it from the user's favourites. The same text is used in both states.

status.action.more.description: Button under a post that opens a menu with more actions on it, and the name of that menu.

status.action.reply.description: Button under a post that starts a reply to it.

status.bookmark.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user removed the bookmark of a post.

status.bookmark.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user bookmarked a post.

status.boost.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user retracted the boost of a post.

status.boost.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user boosted a post.

status.delete.cancel.description: Button in the delete confirmation dialog that keeps the post.

status.delete.confirm.description: Button in the delete confirmation dialog that deletes the post.

status.delete.description.defaultMessage: It will be removed for everyone, along with its boosts and favourites. You cannot undo this.
status.delete.description.description: Text of the dialog that asks the user to confirm deleting their post.

status.delete.done.description: Toast after the user's post was deleted.

status.delete.failed.description: Toast when deleting the user's post failed. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.delete.title.description: Heading of the dialog that asks the user to confirm deleting their post.

status.edit.cancel.description: Button of the dialog that edits the user's post: closes it without saving.

status.edit.close.description: Accessible name of the close (x) button of the dialog that edits the user's post.

status.edit.done.description: Toast after the user's post was edited and saved.

status.edit.failed.description: Shown in the dialog that edits the user's post when saving failed. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.edit.fixed.defaultMessage: The visibility and the post it replies to stay as they are.
status.edit.fixed.description: Note in the dialog that edits the user's post: an edit cannot change these.

status.edit.load_failed.defaultMessage: Could not load the post to edit: {reason}
status.edit.load_failed.description: Shown in the dialog that edits the user's post when its text failed to load. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.edit.loading.description: Accessible name of the spinner while the dialog that edits the user's post loads its text.

status.edit.retry.description: Button that loads the post to edit again after it failed.

status.edit.save.description: Submit button of the dialog that edits the user's post.

status.edit.title.description: Heading of the dialog that edits the user's post, and the name of its form.

status.edited.description: Link under an edited post to its edit history.

status.favourite.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user removed a post from their favourites.

status.favourite.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user favourited a post.

status.focused.boosts.description: Under the body of the post a page is about: how many times it was boosted. Shown only when it was.

status.focused.favourites.description: Under the body of the post a page is about: how many people favourited it. Shown only when someone did.

status.focused.label.description: Not shown: read out by screen readers before the author and time of the post a page is about, to tell it apart from the posts of its thread.

status.history.back.description: Link from a post's edit history to the post's page.

status.history.change.media.description: One of the changes a revision made, joined into {changes} of status.history.changes: the attached media or their descriptions.

status.history.change.sensitive.description: One of the changes a revision made, joined into {changes} of status.history.changes: whether the media are marked sensitive.

status.history.change.text.description: One of the changes a revision made, joined into {changes} of status.history.changes: the text of the post.

status.history.change.warning.description: One of the changes a revision made, joined into {changes} of status.history.changes: the content warning.

status.history.changes.description: What a revision of a post changed from the one before. {changes} is a list of the changes, like text, content warning.

status.history.current.description: Label of the revision that is the post's content now, in the edit history.

status.history.list.description: Accessible name of the list of the revisions of a post.

status.history.original.description: Label of the revision that is the post as first written, in the edit history.

status.history.title.description: Heading and title of the page that lists the revisions of a post.

status.link.copied.description: Toast after the address of a post was copied to the clipboard.

status.link.failed.description: Toast when the browser refused to copy the address of a post to the clipboard.

status.not_found.body.defaultMessage: This post does not exist, or you cannot see it.
status.not_found.body.description: Text under the heading of the page of a post that does not exist or that the user may not see.

status.not_found.title.description: Heading of the page of a post that does not exist or that the user may not see.

status.original.description: Accessible name of the link on a post of another server to its page on that server; the link shows only {host}, that server's host name, for example 'mastodon.social'.

status.pin.action.description: Menu item, on the user's own post, that pins it to the top of their profile.

status.pin.done.description: Toast after the user pinned their post to their profile.

status.pin.failed.description: Toast when pinning the user's post failed, for example because they already pinned as many posts as allowed. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.pin.label.description: Line above a post at the top of a profile that the account pinned there.

status.poll.choose_many.description: Hint above the options of a poll that lets the user choose several of them.

status.poll.choose_one.description: Hint under the options of a poll that lets the user choose one of them.

status.poll.closed.description: Under a poll whose end has passed: it takes no more votes and shows its results.

status.poll.ends.description: Under a poll: when it ends. {time} is a relative time ahead, such as "in 3 hr." or "in 2 days".

status.poll.label.description: Accessible name of the poll of a post: its options or results and how many voted.

status.poll.options.description: Accessible name of the group of radio buttons or checkboxes the user chooses from to vote in a poll.

status.poll.own_vote.description: After an option in the results of a poll that the user voted for.

status.poll.remote_counts.description: Under the results of a poll of a post from another server: the counts are those that server sent last, and a vote of the user shows in them once it sends them again. {host} is that server's host name.

status.poll.results.description: Accessible name of the list of the options of a poll with their share of the votes.

status.poll.vote.description: Button under the options of a poll that sends the user's choice.

status.poll.vote_failed.description: Toast when the user's vote in a poll failed, for example because the poll has ended. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.poll.voted.description: Toast after the user voted in a poll.

status.poll.voters.description: Under a poll: how many accounts voted.

status.poll.votes.description: Under a poll whose number of voters is unknown: how many votes it has, one per chosen option.

status.unpin.action.description: Menu item, on the user's own pinned post, that removes it from the top of their profile.

status.unpin.done.description: Toast after the user unpinned their post from their profile.

status.unpin.failed.description: Toast when unpinning the user's post failed. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.thread.ancestors.description: Heading above the posts that the post of the page replies to, oldest first.

status.thread.failed.description: Shown under the post of the page when its thread failed to load. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

status.thread.loading.description: Visually hidden text that names the busy replies section while the thread around a post loads.

status.thread.no_replies.description: Shown under the Replies heading when the post has no replies.

status.thread.replies.description: Heading above the replies to the post of the page.

status.thread.retry.description: Button that loads the thread around a post again after a failure.

status.title.description: Heading of the page of one post and the thread around it.

tag.title.description: Heading and document title of the page with the posts of one hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag without the #, for example 'cats'.

timeline.boosted_by.description: Line above a post in a timeline that someone else shared (boosted). {name} is the display name of the account that boosted it.

timeline.content_warning.toggle.description: Button next to a post's content warning that shows or hides the post behind it. The same text is used while the post is shown.

timeline.empty.account.heading.description: Shown instead of the posts of a profile's tab when it has none.

timeline.empty.bookmarks.description.defaultMessage: Posts you bookmark appear here. Only you can see your bookmarks.
timeline.empty.bookmarks.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty list of bookmarks.

timeline.empty.bookmarks.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the user has bookmarked none.

timeline.empty.home.action.description: Link from the empty home timeline to the local timeline, where the user can find people to follow.

timeline.empty.home.description.defaultMessage: Your posts and the posts of the people you follow appear here.
timeline.empty.home.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty home timeline.

timeline.empty.home.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the home timeline has none.

timeline.empty.local.description.defaultMessage: Public posts of the people on this server appear here.
timeline.empty.local.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty local timeline.

timeline.empty.local.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the local timeline has none.

timeline.empty.public.description.defaultMessage: Public posts of people here and on the servers this one knows will appear here.
timeline.empty.public.description.description: Text under the heading of the empty federated timeline.

timeline.empty.public.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when the federated timeline has none.

timeline.empty.tag.description.description: Text under the heading of an empty hashtag timeline. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

timeline.empty.tag.heading.description: Heading shown instead of posts when no post has the hashtag. {tag} is the hashtag without the #.

timeline.keyboard_hint.defaultMessage: In the timeline, Page Down and Page Up move between posts.
timeline.keyboard_hint.description: Hint for screen reader users before a timeline, about the keys that move from post to post.

timeline.load_more.description: Button at the end of a timeline that loads older posts.

timeline.load_more.failed.description: Message, read out and shown at the end of a timeline, when older posts failed to load. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

timeline.loading.description: Visually hidden text that names the busy region while posts load: the first page of a timeline, or a post page.

timeline.media.no_description.description: Badge on a picture of a post whose author gave no description (alternative text); screen readers read it as the picture's name.

timeline.media.reveal.description: Toggle button over the pictures of a post that the author marked sensitive; it shows or hides them.

timeline.media.viewer.title.description: Heading of the image viewer, the dialog that shows a picture of a post at its original size when it is pressed. {position} is the place of the picture among the post's pictures, from 1; {count} is how many there are.

timeline.media.viewer.close.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes the image viewer.

timeline.media.viewer.previous.description: Accessible name of the icon button of the image viewer that shows the post's picture before the current one.

timeline.media.viewer.next.description: Accessible name of the icon button of the image viewer that shows the post's next picture.

timeline.card.author.description: Line under the description of a link card naming the author of the linked page. {author} is the author's name as the page gives it, or the verified account (timeline.card.account).

timeline.card.author_published.description: Line under the description of a link card naming the author of the linked page and when it was published. {author} is the author's name; {date} is the formatted date.

timeline.card.published.description: Line under the description of a link card saying when the linked page was published. {date} is the formatted date.

timeline.card.account.description: The verified author of a linked page as an account: {name} is the display name, {handle} the handle such as @alice@example.com.

timeline.card.failed.defaultMessage: Could not show the preview of this link.
timeline.card.failed.description: Shown in place of the card of a link in a post when it failed to render.

timeline.new_posts.defaultMessage: {count, plural, one {# new post} other {# new posts}}
timeline.new_posts.description: Button above the home timeline when new posts have arrived; pressing it shows them at the top. Screen readers also read it out when the count changes.

timeline.new_posts.failed.defaultMessage: Could not load the new posts: {reason}
timeline.new_posts.failed.description: Message read out when pressing the new posts button failed to load them. {reason} is the error message, a full sentence.

timeline.offline.home.defaultMessage: You are offline. These are the posts as of {time}.
timeline.offline.home.description: Notice above the home timeline while the device is offline or the server cannot be reached: the posts shown are the ones loaded last, kept on this device. {time} is the date and time they were loaded, already formatted.

timeline.retry.description: Button at the end of a timeline that tries again to load older posts after a failure.

timeline.signed_out.action.description: Link on the home page, when nobody is signed in, that opens the sign-in page.

timeline.signed_out.description.defaultMessage: Sign in to read the posts of the people you follow.
timeline.signed_out.description.description: Text on the home page when nobody is signed in.

timeline.signed_out.heading.description: Heading on the home page when nobody is signed in, shown instead of the home timeline.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_crea.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator registered a custom emoji of this server.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_imag.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator replaced the image of a custom emoji.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_copi.defaultMessage: Custom emoji copied from another server
admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_copi.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator copied another server's custom emoji into a new emoji of this server.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_upda.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator changed the category, other names, or place in the picker of a custom emoji.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_enab.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator enabled a custom emoji, which is shown again.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_disa.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator disabled a custom emoji, which is shown nowhere.

admin.audit_log.action.custom_emoji_dele.description: Kind of an audited operation: an administrator deleted a custom emoji of this server.

admin.audit_log.target_kind.announcement.description: Kind of target of an audited operation: an announcement, shown by the first line of its text.

admin.audit_log.target_kind.custom_emoji.description: Kind of target of an audited operation: a custom emoji, shown as :shortcode:.

admin.custom_emojis.title.description: Heading of the custom emoji screen, and its link in the administration menu.

admin.custom_emojis.summary.defaultMessage: Register this server's custom emoji, and disable those of other servers.
admin.custom_emojis.summary.description: Description of the custom emoji screen in the administration menu of the settings.

admin.custom_emojis.new.title.description: Heading of the form that registers a custom emoji of this server.

admin.custom_emojis.image.description: Label of the image of a custom emoji, in the form and in an emoji's details.

admin.custom_emojis.image.description.defaultMessage: PNG, GIF, or WebP, at most 1,024 pixels on each side. It is shown within 256 pixels; an animated PNG shows its first frame only.
admin.custom_emojis.image.description.description: Help of the image of a new custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.image.choose.description: Button that opens the file chooser for the image of a new custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.image.chosen.description: The image file chosen for a new custom emoji. {name} is the file name.

admin.custom_emojis.image.large_hint.defaultMessage: This image is larger than 100 KB. Some servers (GoToSocial by default) do not show custom emoji that large.
admin.custom_emojis.image.large_hint.description: Note under a chosen custom emoji image larger than 100 KB; it can still be registered.

admin.custom_emojis.image.required.description: Error of the custom emoji form submitted without an image.

admin.custom_emojis.image_failed.defaultMessage: The server could not process the image.
admin.custom_emojis.image_failed.description: Reason of a failed registration or image replacement when the server could not process the uploaded image.

admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.description: Label of the shortcode of a new custom emoji: the name people type between colons.

admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.descriptio.defaultMessage: 2 to 30 letters (A to Z), digits, and underscores; capitals count. People type it between colons, like :blobcat:. It cannot be changed later.
admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.descriptio.description: Help of the shortcode of a new custom emoji. :blobcat: is an example (not translated).

admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.invalid.defaultMessage: Use 2 to 30 letters (A to Z), digits, and underscores.
admin.custom_emojis.shortcode.invalid.description: Error of a shortcode that is empty or breaks the rules.

admin.custom_emojis.category.description: Label of the category that groups a custom emoji in the picker.

admin.custom_emojis.category.description.defaultMessage: Groups the emoji in the picker. Optional, up to {max} characters.
admin.custom_emojis.category.description.description: Help of the category of a custom emoji. {max} is the most characters.

admin.custom_emojis.aliases.description: Label of the other names that the picker's search finds a custom emoji by.

admin.custom_emojis.aliases.description.defaultMessage: Names that the picker's search also finds the emoji by, separated by spaces or commas; up to {max}, each like a shortcode.
admin.custom_emojis.aliases.description.description: Help of the other names of a custom emoji. {max} is the most names.

admin.custom_emojis.aliases.too_many.description: Error of more other names than allowed. {max} is the most names.

admin.custom_emojis.visible_in_picker.description: Checkbox of whether the picker offers a custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.visible_in_picker.de.defaultMessage: An emoji hidden from the picker can still be typed as its :shortcode:.
admin.custom_emojis.visible_in_picker.de.description: Help of the checkbox of whether the picker offers a custom emoji. :shortcode: is not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.submit.description: Button that registers a new custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.created.description: Status after registering a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.create_failed.defaultMessage: Could not register the custom emoji: {reason}
admin.custom_emojis.create_failed.description: Error under the form when registering a custom emoji failed. {reason} is the localized reason.

admin.custom_emojis.list.title.description: Heading of the list of custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.filter.label.description: Accessible name of the tabs that choose the custom emoji of this server or of other servers.

admin.custom_emojis.filter.local.description: Tab of the custom emoji registered on this server.

admin.custom_emojis.filter.remote.description: Tab of the custom emoji that came from posts and profiles of other servers.

admin.custom_emojis.search.label.description: Accessible name of the search form of the custom emoji list.

admin.custom_emojis.search.shortcode.description: Label of the search field of the custom emoji list: text that the shortcode contains.

admin.custom_emojis.search.domain.description: Label of the search field of another server's domain in the custom emoji list.

admin.custom_emojis.search.submit.description: Button of the search form of the custom emoji list.

admin.custom_emojis.search.clear.description: Button that clears the search of the custom emoji list.

admin.custom_emojis.empty.local.description: Heading of the custom emoji list of this server when none is registered.

admin.custom_emojis.empty.local.descript.defaultMessage: Emoji registered here appear in the picker of the post form and the profile.
admin.custom_emojis.empty.local.descript.description: Description of the empty custom emoji list of this server.

admin.custom_emojis.empty.remote.defaultMessage: No custom emoji of other servers
admin.custom_emojis.empty.remote.description: Heading of the custom emoji list of other servers when none has been seen.

admin.custom_emojis.empty.search.defaultMessage: No custom emoji match the search
admin.custom_emojis.empty.search.description: Heading of the custom emoji list when the search finds nothing.

admin.custom_emojis.domain.description: Term in a remote custom emoji's details: the domain it came from.

admin.custom_emojis.state.description: Term in a custom emoji's details: enabled or disabled.

admin.custom_emojis.state.enabled.description: State of a custom emoji that is shown.

admin.custom_emojis.state.disabled.description: State of a custom emoji that is shown nowhere: its :shortcode: stays text.

admin.custom_emojis.picker.description: Term in a custom emoji's details: whether the picker offers it.

admin.custom_emojis.picker.shown.description: Value of the picker term: the picker offers the emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.picker.hidden.description: Value of the picker term: the picker does not offer the emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.none.description: Value of a custom emoji's category or other names when it has none.

admin.custom_emojis.no_image.defaultMessage: Not shown (its server's media is rejected)
admin.custom_emojis.no_image.description: Value of a remote custom emoji's image when the server does not show it, because a domain action rejects the media of its server.

admin.custom_emojis.updated_at.description: Term in a custom emoji's details: when its current image was set.

admin.custom_emojis.edit.description: Button of a custom emoji that opens the dialog of its settings.

admin.custom_emojis.edit_emoji.description: Accessible name of the edit button of a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.edit.title.description: Title of the dialog of a custom emoji's settings. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.edit.close.description: Accessible name of the close button of the dialog of a custom emoji's settings.

admin.custom_emojis.enabled.description: Checkbox of whether a custom emoji is shown.

admin.custom_emojis.enabled.description.defaultMessage: A disabled emoji is shown nowhere; its :shortcode: stays text.
admin.custom_emojis.enabled.description.description: Help of the checkbox of whether a custom emoji is shown. :shortcode: is not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.save.description: Button that saves the settings of a custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.cancel.description: Button that closes a dialog of a custom emoji without changing it.

admin.custom_emojis.updated.description: Status after saving the settings of a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.change_failed.defaultMessage: Could not change the custom emoji: {reason}
admin.custom_emojis.change_failed.description: Error when changing, replacing the image of, or deleting a custom emoji failed. {reason} is the localized reason.

admin.custom_emojis.replace_image.description: Button of a custom emoji that chooses a new image file for it.

admin.custom_emojis.replace_image_of.description: Accessible name of the button that replaces a custom emoji's image. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.image_replaced.defaultMessage: The image of {emoji} is replaced. Other servers fetch it again.
admin.custom_emojis.image_replaced.description: Status after replacing the image of a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.delete.description: Button of a custom emoji that deletes it, and the confirm button of its dialog.

admin.custom_emojis.delete_emoji.description: Accessible name of the delete button of a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.delete.title.description: Title of the dialog that confirms deleting a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.delete.description.defaultMessage: Posts and profiles that use it show {emoji} as text. A new emoji with the same shortcode is another emoji, and does not appear in them. This cannot be undone.
admin.custom_emojis.delete.description.description: Body of the dialog that confirms deleting a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.deleted.description: Status after deleting a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.copy.description: Button of another server's custom emoji that opens the dialog copying it into an emoji of this server.

admin.custom_emojis.copy_emoji.description: Accessible name of the copy button of another server's custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.copy.title.description: Title of the dialog that copies another server's custom emoji into an emoji of this server. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.copy.description.defaultMessage: This server fetches the image and registers it as its own emoji, shown in the picker. The image shrinks to 256 pixels at most.
admin.custom_emojis.copy.description.description: Body of the dialog that copies another server's custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.copy.close.description: Accessible name of the close button of the dialog that copies another server's custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.copy.submit.description: Confirm button of the dialog that copies another server's custom emoji.

admin.custom_emojis.copied.description: Status after copying another server's custom emoji. {emoji} is the copied emoji's :shortcode:@domain and {copy} the new emoji's :shortcode:, not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.disable.description: Button of another server's custom emoji that stops showing it.

admin.custom_emojis.disable_emoji.description: Accessible name of the disable button of a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.enable.description: Button of another server's custom emoji that shows it again.

admin.custom_emojis.enable_emoji.description: Accessible name of the enable button of a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.disabled_status.description: Status after disabling a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

admin.custom_emojis.enabled_status.description: Status after enabling a custom emoji. {emoji} is the emoji's :shortcode: (with @domain for another server's), not translated.

announcements.heading.description: Heading of one announcement of the server. {date} is the day it started to show, formatted.

announcements.mark_read.description: Button that marks an announcement read.

announcements.mark_read_failed.defaultMessage: The announcement could not be marked as read: {reason}
announcements.mark_read_failed.description: Error after marking an announcement read failed. {reason} is why.

announcements.title.description: Heading of the server's announcements above the home timeline.

announcements.unread.description: Marker of an announcement that the user has not read, next to its heading.

announcements.unread_count.description: The number of unread announcements on the badge next to the heading of the announcements, for example '2 unread'.

announcements.until.description: When an announcement stops showing. {date} is the date and time, formatted.

emoji.picker.button.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the icon button of the post form that opens the custom emoji picker.

emoji.picker.title.description: Accessible name of the popover of the custom emoji picker.

emoji.picker.search.description: Label of the search field of the custom emoji picker; it finds emoji by shortcode or other name.

emoji.picker.grid.description: Accessible name of the grid of emoji in the custom emoji picker.

emoji.picker.recent.description: Heading of the emoji picked recently on this device, first in the picker.

emoji.picker.uncategorized.description: Heading of the emoji without a category in the picker.

emoji.picker.empty.description: What the custom emoji picker shows when nothing matches the search.

settings.profile.display_name.emoji.defaultMessage: Add emoji to the display name
settings.profile.display_name.emoji.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that opens the custom emoji picker for the display name.

settings.profile.note.emoji.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button that opens the custom emoji picker for the bio.

reaction.picker.button.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the icon button in a post's action bar that opens the picker of emoji to react to the post with.

reaction.picker.title.description: Accessible name of the popover that holds the picker of emoji to react to a post with.

reaction.picker.grid.description: Accessible name of the grid of emoji in the picker of reactions.

reaction.picker.unicode.description: Heading of the group of common Unicode emoji in the picker of reactions, before the custom emoji of the server.

reaction.toggle.description: Accessible name of a toggle under a post that reacts to it with an emoji that others reacted with, or takes the reaction back when pressed again. {emoji} is the emoji itself or its :shortcode:. The number of reactions is read as its description.

reaction.list.label.description: Accessible name of the group of emoji reactions under a post.

reaction.list.open.description: Button after the emoji reactions under a post that opens the list of the accounts that reacted.

reaction.list.title.description: Title of the dialog that lists the accounts that reacted to a post, each with its emoji.

reaction.list.close.description: Accessible name of the × button that closes the dialog of the accounts that reacted to a post.

reaction.list.loading.description: Shown in the dialog of the accounts that reacted to a post while the first page loads.

reaction.list.failed.defaultMessage: The reactions could not be loaded: {reason}
reaction.list.failed.description: Shown in the dialog of the accounts that reacted to a post when the first page failed to load. {reason} is the error message.

reaction.list.retry.description: Button that loads the list of the accounts that reacted to a post again after it failed.

reaction.list.empty.description: Shown in the dialog of the accounts that reacted to a post when there are none (the reactions were taken back meanwhile).

reaction.list.load_more.description: Button at the end of the list of the accounts that reacted to a post that loads the next ones.

reaction.list.load_more_failed.defaultMessage: More reactions could not be loaded: {reason}
reaction.list.load_more_failed.description: Shown and announced when the next page of the accounts that reacted to a post failed to load. {reason} is the error message.

status.reaction.on.description: Read out by screen readers after the user reacted to a post with an emoji. {emoji} is the emoji itself or its :shortcode:.

status.reaction.off.description: Read out by screen readers after the user took back their emoji reaction to a post.

settings.domain_mutes.title.description: Heading and document title of the settings page with the domains the user mutes.

settings.domain_mutes.summary.defaultMessage: Servers whose posts and notifications you do not see
settings.domain_mutes.summary.description: Description of the muted domains page in the list of settings pages.

settings.domain_mutes.description.defaultMessage: Muting a domain hides the posts of its accounts, and of its subdomains' accounts, from your timelines other than home, their boosts from your home timeline, and their notifications. The accounts you follow stay on your home timeline. Only you are affected, and the server is not told.
settings.domain_mutes.description.description: Explains what muting a domain does, at the top of the muted domains page.

settings.domain_mutes.new.title.description: Heading of the section of the muted domains page with the form that mutes a domain.

settings.domain_mutes.list.title.description: Heading of the section of the muted domains page that lists them.

settings.domain_mutes.domain.description: Label of the field for the domain to mute.

settings.domain_mutes.domain.description.defaultMessage: The domain of the server, such as mastodon.example. Its subdomains are muted too.
settings.domain_mutes.domain.description.description: Help under the field for the domain to mute.

settings.domain_mutes.domain.required.description: Error under the domain field when the user mutes without entering a domain.

settings.domain_mutes.mute.description: Button that mutes the domain entered in the field.

settings.domain_mutes.mute_failed.description: Shown under the form when muting a domain fails. {reason} is the server's explanation.

settings.domain_mutes.muted.description: Shown under the form after a domain was muted. {domain} is the domain.

settings.domain_mutes.empty.defaultMessage: You do not mute any domain
settings.domain_mutes.empty.description: Shown when the user mutes no domain.

settings.domain_mutes.since.description: When the domain was muted, under a muted domain. {date} is a formatted date and time.

settings.domain_mutes.unmuted.description: Announced after a domain was unmuted. {domain} is the domain.

settings.import_export.kind.domain_mutes.description: Name of the list of domains the user mutes, as one kind of CSV file to export or import.
